elements.name: The pilgrim's Hajj
elements.documentation: This guide's user scenarios told as one pilgrim's story, moment by moment along the overview of key process flows (steps 1–5 and A–B): Kamal, 61, from Kuala Terengganu, performs Hajj for the first time. Each moment (P0 to P7) is a sub-journey: who takes part, what happens, what in this guide specifies it, what it does not yet specify, and the policy question it raises. The setting follows the guide's Malaysian reference implementation. Every person is fictional. Told in prose on the guide's page input/pagecontent/pilgrim-journey.md.

properties.value: SMART Verifiable IPS for Pilgrimage (litlfred/smart-ips-pilgrimage): the pilgrim's journey and the overview of key process flows

elements.name: P0 · Before the season — keys and codes are shared
elements.documentation: Malaysia's HIE publishes the public keys it signs health documents with to the WHO GDHCN trust network, and shares the national code systems its IPS uses with the WHO Terminology Service. Nothing about Kamal yet: this is what lets a Saudi clinic trust and read a Malaysian record months later. Step A of the overview of key process flows.

properties.value: SMART Verifiable IPS for Pilgrimage (litlfred/smart-ips-pilgrimage): the pilgrim's journey and the overview of key process flows

elements.name: P1 · The health check and the choice to share
elements.documentation: Three months before Hajj, Kamal has the mandatory pre-Hajj health examination with Dr Aisyah. He is fit to travel. She explains what the Hajj Health Record is, who can see it, and for how long. Kamal agrees on his wallet to share his patient summary with Saudi health workers during Hajj, and sets how the link to it is protected. Step 1 of the overview of key process flows.

properties.value: A GP clinic in Kuala Terengganu
SMART Verifiable IPS for Pilgrimage (litlfred/smart-ips-pilgrimage): the pilgrim's journey and the overview of key process flows

elements.name: P2 · His summary is assembled and signed
elements.documentation: Malaysia's HIE assembles Kamal's International Patient Summary from his care history: his conditions, his medicines, his allergy. It issues a Verifiable Health Link to it, signs it with a key registered with GDHCN, and puts the QR code in his wallet. Step 2 of the overview of key process flows.

properties.value: SMART Verifiable IPS for Pilgrimage (litlfred/smart-ips-pilgrimage): the pilgrim's journey and the overview of key process flows

elements.name: P3 · Taken ill in Mina
elements.documentation: On the second day in Mina, in the heat, Kamal feels dizzy and weak. Salmah brings him to the Hajj health facility. At registration he opens his wallet and shows Nurse Reem the QR code. Step 3 of the overview of key process flows.

properties.value: A Hajj health facility in Mina
SMART Verifiable IPS for Pilgrimage (litlfred/smart-ips-pilgrimage): the pilgrim's journey and the overview of key process flows

elements.name: P4 · Scanned and checked
elements.documentation: Nurse Reem scans the code in the facility's EMR and enters the passcode. The EMR checks the signature with Malaysia's public key, fetched from GDHCN: the record really comes from Malaysia's HIE and has not been changed. Step 4 and step B of the overview of key process flows.

properties.value: SMART Verifiable IPS for Pilgrimage (litlfred/smart-ips-pilgrimage): the pilgrim's journey and the overview of key process flows

elements.name: P5 · His record is read and he is treated
elements.documentation: The EMR follows the link to Malaysia's HIE and retrieves Kamal's summary. Dr Faisal sees the insulin and the penicillin allergy before he treats him for heat exhaustion and low blood sugar. The EMR keeps a rendered copy of the summary with the record of the visit. Step 5 of the overview of key process flows.

properties.value: Treatment bay, Hajj health facility, Mina
SMART Verifiable IPS for Pilgrimage (litlfred/smart-ips-pilgrimage): the pilgrim's journey and the overview of key process flows

elements.name: P6 · When he cannot show the code (break the glass)
elements.documentation: On the day of Arafat Kamal collapses and is brought in unconscious. Salmah is not with him. Dr Hafiz of the Malaysian medical team gives his Hajj registration number, and the facility reaches his summary through it. Described in this guide's user scenarios as a Phase 2 scenario.

elements.name: P7 · Back home
elements.documentation: Kamal comes home. His GP in Kuala Terengganu does not know he was treated in Mina. After the story this guide tells.
